title: Critical: Handle leak in shared memory (lib.rs)
description: OpenFileMappingW handles are never closed with CloseHandle in both new() and pull(). In pull(), this leaks ~7200 handles/hour. Files: lib.rs:149, lib.rs:242
resolution: Added CloseHandle after MapViewOfFile in both new() and pull()

title: Critical: Panic with GameSense + Custom mode (main.rs:744)
description: hid_api is only initialized when direct_usb=true, but run_sensors() unconditionally unwraps it. Causes crash with MOUSE_BATTERY or MEDIA_* sensors on GameSense connection.
resolution: Changed run_sensors to accept Option<&HidApi>, updated mouse_battery to handle None

title: Critical: Icon unwrap panic (main.rs:477)
description: Icon loading handles errors gracefully (returns None), but then panics on .unwrap(). Application crashes if icon fails to load.
resolution: Made icon optional in tray builder, continues without icon if loading fails

title: Critical: Missing null check in pull() (lib.rs:242)
description: No null check after OpenFileMappingW before passing to MapViewOfFile, unlike new() which properly checks.
resolution: Added null check after OpenFileMappingW in pull()

title: Important: Unsafe memory alignment (lib.rs:176-182)
description: Uses align_to::<T>() without verifying alignment succeeded. Could panic or produce garbage if alignment wrong.
resolution: Added is_empty() checks before accessing aligned slices

title: Important: Multiple unwraps on Optional fields (main.rs)
description: Several unwraps on Option<T> fields: event_loop_proxy (415), hwinfo (534), config_file (542). Could panic during initialization.
resolution: Replaced all unwraps with ok_or_else() with descriptive error messages

title: Important: Settings wizard unwraps (settings.rs:226,246)
description: Sensor lookups in config wizard panic if data changes between display and selection.
resolution: Replaced unwraps with ok_or_else() returning proper errors

title: Test failure: test_appconfig_missing_style (settings.rs:485)
description: Test expects error when style is missing but code provides default. Test is out of sync with implementation.
resolution: Updated test to expect success with vertical summary mode as default
